project.title: The Excavation Suit
project.description: A speculative multimodal suit for colonists on Proxima Centauri b who reopen the nuclear waste sites their ancestors buried.
project.introText: The Excavation Suit is a speculative wearable for a Multimodal Interaction Design course: a suit for the descendants of a colony on Proxima Centauri b, who reopen the nuclear waste sites their ancestors sealed.
project.middleText: Radio fails under the star's flares, so gesture is a primary input, and every hazard registers across at least two of touch, vision and sound. This follows the Sandia recommendation that nuclear warnings be layered across several channels, and the "ray cat" idea of a warning that needs no literacy. Before leaving, the wearer marks the site for the next crew.
project.conclusionText: The midterm prototype is an Arduino glove and forearm rig for the haptic and gesture loops, with a helmet-mounted colour sensor and an OLED display.
